generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Since subject tender is for works, EMD exemption is not allowed for MSME registered with NSIC. Hence all tenderers participating in this bid shall arrange for payment of EMD online in the e-Portal.

Aspiring Bidders/ Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in Karnataka Public Procurement Portal may now obtain the same from the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in

The tender is of Two Part Tender document system i.e. Part-I: Technical Bid & Part-II: Financial Bid. Part-II: Financial Bid of Bidder will be considered for opening only if Part-I: Technical Bid meets the requisite PQRs and Technical Specifications.
Section-I, II, III, Instruction to bidders, Form of Submission of Bid and Self Declaration are part of the Tender document.

The bidder should have independent PF (Provident Fund) registration certificate obtained from PF authorities. Copy of PF registration certificate shall be furnished with the tender. EPF Exemption Declaration may be furnished by the bidder, if exempted.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the undersigned.
The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST as per the latest GOK/ GOI orders.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/ indicated in tender may vary depending on the final requirement at the time of placing the Work Order.

Bidders may visit the site at Linganamakki Power House before bidding to inspect and obtain the hands-on information about the work from the concerned division head. The bidder shall obtain visitors pass to visit KPCL office/ LPH before entering KPCL premises.

Post-tender correspondences regarding technical specification, scope of work involved will not be entertained and it is the responsibility of the bidders to get any queries cleared before bidding for the subject work.

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/ agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection.

Corrigendum or Modification or Corrections if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification, contact the Office of the Executive Engineer (O&M) LPH, Linganamakki Power House, KPCL, Linganamakki-577421, Sagara Tq., Shimoga Dist., Karnataka.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a registered Contractor/ Agency/ Firm and have proven experience in carrying out Supply & installation of LED illumination works to any Power Houses/ Dams/ Power Utilities. In proof, shall furnish scanned copy of at least one single work order with contract value not less than Rs 5.27 Lakh and corresponding satisfactory work completion certificate issued from the competent authority. (Work done of previous five financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

The L1 bidder shall compulsorily submit one sample fitting as per the specification within 1 month from the date of Agreement. The sample fitting shall be tested in front of Engineer-in-charge and approved by division head. If the supplied sample is not acceptable by KPCL, L1 bidder shall submit the sample again within 15 days from the date of intimation till the sample is accepted.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Dismantling of existing lighting system, Supply & fixing of 24 Volts AC Light Fittings to Linganamakki dam drainage galleries

itemList.description: Dismantling of existing wirings, fittings and handing over the same to KPCL

Supply and fixing of underwater light fitting made with borosilicate glass tube flush/ liner/ wall mounting type consisting of 24 volts AC, 1 x 11/12 Watts with solid state lighting & driver of 24 volts AC, 12 Watts, operation with variation of 20% plus or minus. 50HZ., and with safety protection of abnormal operations. Fittings shall have connecting lead. The Fittings should withstand 3 bar under water pressure. Lamp fittings shall be fixed on surface as directed by work incharge using rawal plugs & SS bolts, Protection rating: IP-68

Supply and fixing of PVC Insulated and sheathed 4 Sq mm multistrand copper cable flat, 2 core water proof Power flex make with ISI mark (IS694), Directly fixing on the wall with cable type and tie mount at 1 meter distance. Tie mount fitted with SS screws or strong adhesive on the wall.
Supplying and fixing PVC Flexible conduit pipe 12/ 19 mm with check nut and coupler.
Supply & fixing of IP 65 Junction box for tapping supply to the Individual light fittings
Repair & servicing of existing control panel alongwith replacement of 1 No. varnish impregnated transformer 415/ 240 Volts secondary 24 volts 1.5 KVA
